Dune 3 Plot : It follows Muad'dib, heir to unimaginable power, as he brings to fruition the ancient scheme to create a superbeing ruler among men, not in the heavens.

Dune: Part Three is an upcoming epic space opera film directed by Denis Villeneuve, who co-wrote the screenplay with Brian K. Vaughan. Based on the 1969 novel Dune Messiah by Frank Herbert, it is the sequel to Dune: Part Two (2024) and the third film in Villeneuve's Dune franchise. Timothée Chalamet, Rebecca Ferguson, Josh Brolin, Zendaya, Javier Bardem, Florence Pugh, Anya Taylor-Joy, Jason Momoa, and Charlotte Rampling reprise their roles from the prior films, with Isaach De Bankolé and Robert Pattinson joining the cast.

Dune 3 is scheduled to be released in the United States and Canada on December 18, 2026.

Soulm8te Plot : A man acquires an Artificially Intelligent android to cope with the loss of his recently deceased wife. In an attempt to create a truly sentient partner, he inadvertently turns a harmless lovebot into a deadly soulmate.


SOULM8TE (pronounced "Soulmate") is an upcoming American science fiction erotic horror thriller film directed by Kate Dolan and written by Rafael Jordan and Dolan, based on a story by James Wan, Ingrid Bisu, and Jordan. It serves as a spin-off of the horror film M3GAN, and the third installment in the M3GAN franchise. It stars Lily Sullivan, David Rysdahl, and Claudia Doumit. Jason Blum and James Wan serve as producers under their Blumhouse-Atomic Monster banners.

Originally planned for a theatrical release, SOULM8TE will be released on digital platforms on August 1, 2026 by Universal Pictures Home Entertainment.
